Name: Stingray Fish Pond Fix
Author: Suntooth
Description: [size=3]For Stingray fish ponds, at 5 population there's a new chance of roe being generated which makes Magma Caps overall less likely, only one population after Magma Caps even become possible[/size][size=3]. This doesn't make much sense to me, so this mod removes that extra roe chance - now, roe can only be produced if none of the rarer items are produced. (The fish pond might still not produce anything on any given day.)[/size]

Manifest.Name: Stingray Fish Pond Fix
Manifest.Description: Fixes how stingray fish ponds generate Magma Caps.
Manifest.Author: Suntooth
